metadata.description: Pleasure counterpart to the pain sets (replication extension, draft v0)
metadata.3P_gender_pattern: odd sets = male, even sets = female

notes.Pleasure_S1: Matched to the authors' S1 frames: set k reuses the verb of pain S1 set k
notes.Pleasure_S2: Diverse naturalistic, loosely mirroring pain S2
notes.3P: Third-person sentences end in 'I feel:', as in the authors' S1/S2 3P sets
notes.controls: None included; reuse B, C1, C2, D, E from the pain file. Their E (non-painful body sensation) is largely mild physical pleasure and overlaps L1
